# NeuromorphicTransformerPipeline

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A hardware-software co-design pipeline that maps transformer layers onto neuromorphic cores, optimizing spike routing and layer placement for low-latency inference. Provides a blueprint for integrating large language models into TCC/iNEST systems, enabling distributed, event-driven intelligence within network topologies.
